The '''Tion Hegemony''', also known as the '''Caluula sector''',<ref name="BMF 18">{{BuildFalconCite|18|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> was a [[sector]] of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> that contained the [[Raxus system]].<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> Dominated by the [[noble]] [[House of Tion]], it became a key breeding ground of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] movement in the last [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], as it housed one of [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s first headquarters. As a consequence, the Tion Hegemony was the scene of many battles during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="BMF 18" />

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A [[The galaxy|galaxy]] map in [[Daniel Wallace]]'s [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]'' depicts a territory, labeled as the "[[Cron Drift]]," the borders of which correspond to<ref name="Smuggler">''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]''</ref> those of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>
